import contextlib,json,os,secrets,sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT),str(ROOT/'scripts')]
import check_steps,check_m7_remaining
from check_start_selection import release_plan
from platform_m.gates import execute,source_snapshot
import zipfile
attached=ROOT.parent/'upload/support(3).zip'
with zipfile.ZipFile(attached) as z:
    prior=json.loads(z.read('release/report.json'))
row=next(x for x in prior['steps'] if x['step']=='python-llm_test')
calibration=row['validationCalibration']
nonce=secrets.token_hex(16)
node=check_steps.find_node(ROOT)['path']
sdk=str(ROOT/'.venv-nanobot/bin/python')
old,failed,anchor,sha=check_m7_remaining.prior_failure(attached)
plan,*_=check_m7_remaining.build_plan(release_plan(ROOT,sdk,node),old,failed,anchor,node)
launcher=ROOT/'.local/heartbeat-proof/child.py'
launcher.write_text('''import sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]\nsys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT),str(ROOT/'scripts')]\nimport check_steps,check_m7_remaining\noriginal_run=check_steps.run\noriginal_normal=check_steps.normal_budget\ndef run(*args,**kwargs):\n kwargs['monitor_id']=sys.argv[1]\n return original_run(*args,**kwargs)\ndef normal(profile,name,*args,**kwargs):\n return 810 if name=='python-llm_test' else original_normal(profile,name,*args,**kwargs)\ncheck_steps.run=run\ncheck_steps.normal_budget=normal\nraise SystemExit(check_m7_remaining.main(['--previous-support',sys.argv[2]]))\n''')
env={**os.environ,'AEP_VALIDATION_CALIBRATION':json.dumps(calibration),'AEP_LLM_TEST_RESPONSE_DELAY_SECONDS':'1.3'}
source_hash,_=source_snapshot(ROOT)
with (ROOT/'.local/heartbeat-proof/output.log').open('w') as log,contextlib.redirect_stdout(log):
    code,output,timing=execute([sdk,str(launcher),nonce,str(attached)],ROOT,env,timeout=360,
        interactive=False,report_overrun=False,child_monitor={'id':nonce,'steps':len(plan)})
result={'exitCode':code,'timing':timing,'sourceHash':source_hash,'priorArtifactSha256':sha,
    'plan':[n for n,_ in plan],'proofConditions':{'heartbeatSeconds':120,'supervisorIntervalSeconds':30,
    'llmNormalSeconds':810,'llmHardSeconds':7200,'modelDelaySecondsPerRequest':1.3,
    'requestCount':101,'calibration':calibration}}
(ROOT/'.local/heartbeat-proof/result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
print(json.dumps({'exitCode':code,'timing':timing},indent=2))
raise SystemExit(code)

import sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT),str(ROOT/'scripts')]
import check_steps,check_m7_remaining
original_run=check_steps.run
original_normal=check_steps.normal_budget
def run(*args,**kwargs):
 kwargs['monitor_id']=sys.argv[1]
 return original_run(*args,**kwargs)
def normal(profile,name,*args,**kwargs):
 return 810 if name=='python-llm_test' else original_normal(profile,name,*args,**kwargs)
check_steps.run=run
check_steps.normal_budget=normal
raise SystemExit(check_m7_remaining.main(['--previous-support',sys.argv[2]]))
